Subject: Narrowing the gap: forecast lock & pricing triage for Lumina Data

Team —

Quick note ahead of the Monday forecast lock. Lumina (DL-4821) is showing as a likely close but the committed ARR in the forecast is contingent on an outstanding pricing approval and a clarified discount cadence. If we don’t get formal pricing authorization in the next 72 hours, we should not mark this as Commit for the week close.

Background / current state:
- ACV under review: $1.35M first-year ARR (renewal cadence included).
- Current proposed discount: 28% (sales-led concession).
- Deal stage: Negotiation/Verbal but not yet in Commit. HubSpot shows expected close 11/12/2026.

Immediate asks (action owners in parentheses):
1) Move to commit only after Deal Desk approval is attached to the HubSpot deal (Vanessa / Marissa).
2) If Deal Desk needs to reduce concession to hit finance thresholds, propose the updated price and required approval path in the Deal Desk form (Marissa).
3) Finance to confirm whether this can be accepted into the November commit with a pending CFO signoff or whether we must push to coverage next quarter (Marcus).

Attachments: deal-desk-request-lumina.xlsx (please populate fields), lumina_term_sheet_v3.pdf.

Please update the HubSpot deal with a Deal Desk ticket link and tag me. If we can get approvals by end-of-day Monday 11/09 I'll leave this as Commit; otherwise we revert to Best Case.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Note: Bethany / Lumina procurement — looping you in so approvals are aligned and we can close on the proposed commercial terms. If there are internal timelines on your side that would accelerate review, flag here and we will prioritize the internal approvals.

Adding some detail from legal/pricing side — I’ve attached the redlines to the term sheet and a more explicit concession breakdown. Highlights:
- Concession breakdown: 20% list + 8% one‑time onboarding credit = 28% effective.
- Suggested alternate: 22% list + 3% onboarding = 25% effective (accepts lower onboarding credit).
- Risk note: If we accept 28% and include standard support terms, our unit economics dip below target for year 1 but shipments are strategically valuable given Lumina’s integration roadmap.

I’ve populated the deal-desk-request-lumina.xlsx with the options and rationale. If Deal Desk or Finance need a more conservative option, please use the 25% path and I will rework the term sheet.

Attachments: redlines-lumina.docx, updated deal-desk-request-lumina.xlsx (attached in ticket).

All —

Quick finance guidance: thanks for the options. Two points to lock in before we include Lumina in the November commit:
1) Any net discount greater than 25% requires CFO approval per the discounting policy (see internal policy). If Deal Desk submits a 28% ask, route to CFO for expedited review — provide clear ARR carry, margin impact, and strategic rationale.
2) Confirm the recognition plan: if Lumina signs before 11/12 we can include Q4 recognition subject to standard revenue reallocation rules. If the signature slips beyond 11/12 we should move to next-period coverage.

Action items for closure: 
- Vanessa: attach the Deal Desk ticket ID and include the populated economics tab (unit margin, expected first-year contribution).
- Marissa: if you can prepare a one-pager with the two pricing options and the preferred fallback (22%/25%), finance will expedite CFO review if required.
- Karthik: if needed, I can fast-track the CFO loop but need the economics packet by EOD Monday 11/09.

I’ll hold a brief 15-minute sync Monday morning if anyone wants to walk through the economics before routing to CFO.

Marcus Lin
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
